@graph.description: All Reliable Cleaning provides end of lease, regular house, office and carpet steam cleaning across Perth.

@graph.name: Regular house cleaning in Perth
@graph.description: Weekly or fortnightly house cleaning in Perth, priced per visit with no lock-in contract.

mainEntity.name: How much does a regular house clean cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fortnightly cleans start from $149 per visit. Your price depends on home size and how often we visit.

mainEntity.name: Is there a bond, deposit or lock-in contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There’s no upfront bond and no lock-in contract. Cancel any time with 24 hours’ notice.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most clients leave a key or lockbox code, and we lock up when we finish. You can also be home if you prefer.

mainEntity.name: We have pets. Is that OK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell us about your pets in the form. We vacuum pet hair every visit, and we ask you to secure any pet that might slip out the door.

mainEntity.name: Can I skip or move a visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell us at least 24 hours before and we move or skip that visit at no cost.

mainEntity.name: Do you bring your own products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We bring the vacuum, mop and products. If you want us to use your own products, leave them out and we’ll use them.
